request.message: JSON response or one callback object; empty for request
request.parameters: non-secret legacy parameters; new vendor constants belong in code

input.candidates: up to 200 goods objects: product_code, quantity, uom, lot

request.headers?: optional text map; $app_key / $app_secret are resolved locally, omitted when blank; default Bearer uses the category Token

callback.destination_code: exact same-company, current-warehouse internal location barcode or AGV code, or empty

syntax: JSON literals, local assignments, if/else, for candidate in candidates, .get, local .append, slices, str/int/float/len; no imports, eval, ORM, attributes or networking
callback_lookup: one exact existing task ID in the JSON values; pinned code maps task_id and completion
writebacks: published code chooses subposition and/or destination_code; fixed service validates final step, warehouse, company, stock and capacity
